featured_reviews.review_text:
We have been using Healkin for the past 6 months for both home nursing support and caregiver services, and our experience has been consistently excellent. The staff has been professional, compassionate, dependable, and extremely patient in handling day-to-day care needs.

What truly stands out is the responsiveness and sense of responsibility of their coordination team. On one occasion, due to an unforeseen last-minute issue with the scheduled nurse for the next day, Krithika went the extra mile late at night and arranged a replacement to ensure there was absolutely no disruption in care. That level of commitment and ownership gave us tremendous peace of mind.

Over the months, we have found the nurses to be clinically competent and attentive, while the caregivers have been warm, respectful, and genuinely caring towards the patient and family alike. Managing home care over an extended period can be stressful, and having a reliable agency like this has made a meaningful difference for us.

Would highly recommend Healkin to anyone looking for trustworthy home healthcare and caregiving support.

featured_reviews.name: Monil Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: AVOID AT ALL COST!! This agency is nothing but a bunch of hooligans working together. We had a 6 month relationship during which they were paid in lakhs for their nurses. When we switched to caretaker, their service deteriorated. Firstly, they sent over someone who had no qualifications whatsoever, sat around for hours glancing at her phone and when we had her sent back for a replacement they asked for a full day's payment even when the person was physically present for less than 12 hours. We still paid for a 12 hour shift (which we shouldn't have) based on the discount approved but they claimed to not honor the same discounted rate when the service duration was reduced. After paying in lakhs, they came to our doorstep to demand ₹800 and created havoc like homeless hooligans. Their staff including Kritika and Namita (Manager) used foul language when we discussed the remainder payment. I find this agency is run by a bunch of unqualified and illiterate individuals. There is no organizational hierarchy and when asked for higher-up managers, there is no one ever present to handle such situations in a cordial manner. If you care for your loved one, I'd recommend not using any of their services.

name: Dignity Dementia Day Care Centre, Mumbai
description:
Dementia i.e. Alzheimer’s and related disorders are getting increasingly common among senior citizens in India. Due to its progressive nature & lack of medical treatments, caring for those with Dementia is critical. In Mumbai, Dignity Foundation is successfully running a Dementia Day Care Centre, catering to the unmet needs of the city.
Our Dementia Day Care Centre is staffed with trained caregivers who provide elder care with compassion. They manage members’ mood swings, aggression & other behavioural symptoms successfully.
We offer home pick-up and drop service along with daily lunch and refreshments. Members get therapies & engage in social interactions to stay active. We have other centres in New Delhi, Pune, Kolkata and Chennai.

featured_reviews.review_text:
5 stars! My wife recently gave birth at Agarwal Nursing Home and had an absolutely wonderful experience from start to finish.
Dr. Meera Agarwal was outstanding—knowledgeable, patient, and incredibly supportive throughout the journey. They explained everything clearly, listened to my wife concerns, and made her feel confident and calm during what could have been a stressful time.

Dear Dr. Meera and the entire medical team,
We can’t fully express the gratitude we feel in our hearts for the care and compassion you gave our beloved mother during her surgery. Being far away from her during such a critical moment was incredibly painful for us — but knowing she was in your gentle, capable hands brought us so much peace and comfort in our absence.

You weren’t just doing a job — you were a source of strength, mercy, and healing when we couldn’t be by her side. Please extend our heartfelt thanks to every nurse, assistant, and staff member who cared for her with patience, kindness, and dignity. Your efforts reached not just her — but touched our hearts as well.

May the lord reward each of you abundantly, bless your hands with shifa, your hearts with light, and your work with endless barakah. May He continue to make you a means of healing for many more families, just as you were for ours.

With endless appreciation,
From Tabassum’s children

featured_reviews.name: vivek kejriwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this to express my heartfelt gratitude to Nirmala and Aarush Home Care Services. When my father suffered a stroke and became immobile, our family was going through one of the most difficult phases of our lives — and that is when we found Aarush.

Because of her nursing background and deep understanding of patient care, Nirmala immediately assessed my father’s condition and selected the most suitable “Brother” (nurse) for him. He was not only highly qualified, but more importantly, truly compassionate and committed. Empathy and dedication are not easy to find — and this combination made all the difference for my father.

What stood out most to me was that Nirmala never treated this as “just another case.” In a market where elderly care services are rapidly mushrooming, she brings sincerity, discipline, and heart. She followed up regularly, checked on the caregiver’s behavior, performance, and skills, and made sure everything at home was handled with dignity and respect.

There were times when the caregiver needed leave — but we never felt insecure or helpless. Nirmala ensured timely replacements without a single gap in care. That reliability is priceless when you are caring for an elderly parent.

She is strongly supported by Santosh, who is always responsive and dependable.

If someone is looking for elderly care that is not only efficient and professional — but also humane, trustworthy, and compassionate — I can say with complete confidence that Aarush Home Care Services is the right choice.

I remain deeply thankful to Nirmala. Her commitment and knowledge helped ease our worries and played a significant role in my father’s recovery.

Wishing you continued strength and success, Nirmala.
